measurement_and_projection.pre_update_state: For SHAM and SUBSPACE_PROJECT, source and all 31 target gradients are measured from the identical pre-update model/optimizer state and source RNG start.
measurement_and_projection.project_rule: Select every target with negative source-target dot and target norm^2 above the floor; project the source gradient onto the orthogonal complement of their simultaneous span, then apply the ordinary global clip and AdamW step.
measurement_and_projection.projection_rule: g' = g - T pinv(T^T T) T^T g
measurement_and_projection.sham_rule: Measure the same source/31-target gradient geometry, restore the source post-forward RNG state, apply the untouched source gradient, then perform the ordinary clipped AdamW step.

nonclaims: EXP-335 does not establish Stage-B IID generalization.
EXP-335 does not establish Stage-C generator-heldout transfer.
EXP-335 does not test always-active persistent state or online plasticity.
EXP-335 does not authorize EXP-320 implementation.
EXP-335 does not authorize scaling to 30M or 100M.
EXP-335 does not retroactively alter EXP-301 KILL_H_RD_01 or EXP-319 TRAINING_STACK_NOT_LEARNABLE.
primary_gate: At exposure 32, every one of the 32 worlds must simultaneously satisfy token accuracy >=0.99 and full-answer exact >=0.90 with zero nonfinite events.

interpretation.AFIXED_FULL32_FOUNDATION_REENTERED_BOTH: CONTROL and SUBSPACE_PROJECT both pass the full-32 final foundation gate. The balanced schedule alone is sufficient at this continuation state; projection is non-regressing.
interpretation.AFIXED_FULL32_FOUNDATION_REENTERED_CONTR: CONTROL passes but projection fails at least one world. A_FIXED foundation re-entry is established for the balanced control schedule, but the all-32 projection intervention is not safe.
interpretation.AFIXED_FULL32_FOUNDATION_REENTRY_NOT_EST: The full-32 A_FIXED foundation floor remains unmet after the preregistered intervention.
interpretation.AFIXED_FULL32_FOUNDATION_REENTRY_RESCUED: CONTROL fails, projection engages, SUBSPACE_PROJECT passes all 32 worlds, and no world that passed under CONTROL becomes failing under PROJECT.
interpretation.BASELINE_FULL32_FAILURE_WITHOUT_SUBSPACE: CONTROL fails and the PROJECT path records no projection update; the registered mechanism did not engage.

scientific_question: From the immutable A_FIXED 10M step-2048 reconstruction, does a balanced full-32-world Stage-A continuation re-enter the frozen teacher-forced foundation floor, either without intervention or under the exact EXP-334 conflict-subspace projection generalized to all other 31 worlds at each source update, while SHAM proves measurement non-perturbation?

successor_boundary.positive_scope: May authorize design/preregistration only for C_NRS_CORE full-32 Stage-A re-entry under the corresponding repaired foundation. Does not authorize C_NRS implementation in this EXP-335 design phase.

training.effort_assignment: world-local exposure index j; every world uses effort_cycle[j mod 4]
training.within_exposure_order: families in frozen population order; within each family world index 0..7
